llm_response.reason: The site mimics a legitimate brand (Floris Van Bommel) and presents urgency tactics ('hot sale', 'free shipping'), ambiguous privacy claims, and psychological assurances. The contact/inquiry page is inaccessible, which is commonly used to hide true business details. The legitimacy of the company and appropriateness of contact methods cannot be verified. Combined, these fit the scam characteristics: brand spoofing, urgency tactics, ambiguous privacy/policy info, and non-appropriate inquiry method.
